title: Forward deployed engineering roles tripled their share in the last 6 months on Contrario
summary: Forward deployed roles grew from 3.5% to 11.5% of engineering roles on Contrario in six months. See which engineering roles startups need now, and what they pay.
body_markdown: 58% of the roles startups post on Contrario are engineering: 385 of 661 since May 2025. Almost all come from young teams. 72% are from Seed or Series A companies, and 85% from teams of 50 or fewer. Here's what those startups need from engineers, and how that's changing.
